newsitem.title: USA: North America bunkers higher on strong gasoil.
newsitem.headline: North America bunkers higher on strong gasoil.

text.p: North American bunker prices continued to climb this week as cold weather and snow gripped parts of the U.S. and fired up heating oil futures, players said on Thursday.
Strong gas oil futures also helped support the market.
"The gasoil contract has gone up dramatically this week and it is pushing the price of bunkers up," said one East Coast trader.
Players said they expected further increases Friday and next week because many suppliers were working off old inventories, which were bought at lower values.
